blocks.html:
Van Decals

This is the 2nd of three vans CoolCheck has commissioned Vinyl Wrap Toronto to decal recently. The decals for each of the vans are slightly different due to the shape and size. CoolCheck did make one change from the 1st van decals to this one. The CoolCheck logo Decals on the side of this Savannah van needed to be at an angle to match all their branding. View some of the previous vehicles Vinyl Wrap Toronto has wrapped such as these van decals for CoolCheck.
This GMC Savannah van came straight from the dealer and is to replace an existing van. The vehicle arrived covered in snow, which meant we were not able to do anything with the van until it was cleaned. Any water, dirt, or salt would be trapped under the vinyl and cause bubbles or imperfections.

Every vehicle or piece of equipment’s surface we apply vinyl is thoroughly cleaned before installation. Each installer has its own solution and cleaning methods. Our crew has multiple years of experience working in various shops around the GTA. Call us at 416-746-1381 to speak to our installation crew.
Vinyl Wrap Toronto can use the same logo we apply to the vehicles to brand any item you wish. Whether with vinyl or printed, we can brand anything with your company logo.
